target.name: DWS RREEF World Real Estate Fund, Inc.

acquirer.name: DWS RREEF Global Real Estate Securities Fund

listed_quote.quote: calling for the merger of your Fund into the DWS RREEF Global Real Estate Securities Fund, an open-end investment company.

announcement.quote: Completion of the proposed merger is subject to a number of conditions and other factors, including final Board approval and approval by shareholders.

deals.notes: Closed-end DRP (NYSE) merging into an open-end fund. The October 2010 press release excerpt does not name the acquirer; the December 2010 proxy reminder does. Stockholders approved on January 12, 2011 (0000088053-11-000215), the merger was expected to complete on or about February 25, 2011, and the N-8F (0000088053-12-000035) records a merger deregistration with a shareholder vote on 1/12/11 and distributions on 2/28/11.
